title: Pioneer On-Ramp: compact starter frames and contextual microtips
creator: Tomas Nguyen
content:
Summary:
Compact, mobile-friendly starter frames and contextual microtips for the Console first-run experience. The goal is to reduce time-to-first-success for new users by providing a lightweight, progressive checklist and tailored empty-state illustrations that fit into the redesigned Console header/side rail layout. This ticket covers the design deliverables, specs, and handoff artifacts for the asset pack and the copy variants used in A/B experiments.

Background and goals:
- Current onboarding assets are visually heavy and assume desktop-first flows; analytics show drop-off on initial route setup (first 5 minutes).
- Deliver a modular asset kit (tiles, header banners, microtips, empty-state illustrations, and screenshot overlays) that can be composed for: first-run checklist, route-level empty states, and in-context microtips.
- Optimize for compact vertical stacks, 320–1440px, and ensure clear states for: empty, in-progress, success, error.

Deliverables (design files & artifacts):
1) Figma master file (components + pages): https://www.figma.com/file/REDACTED/pioneer-onramp-slate
   - Pages: Tokens, Components, Templates, Screenshots, Copy Variants, Export/QA
2) PNG/SVG export set in Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/REDACTED (organized by density and theme)
3) Annotated spec doc in Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/UX/pages/REDACTED
4) Prototype: clickable first-run flow with microtip sequencing (Figma prototyping)
5) Small sprite set for empty states and 3x scale PNGs for mobile and retina displays

Asset inventory and naming convention (for handoff):
- pioneer_tile_compact_v1.svg (3 color themes: neutral, spark, emphasis)
- pioneer_tile_expanded_v1.svg
- pioneer_empty_illustration_onramp_v1.svg (variants: no-data, error-retry, permissions-needed)
- pioneer_microtip_pill_sm_v1.svg / pioneer_microtip_pill_lg_v1.svg
- screenshot_overlay_callout_v1.png (with transparent rectangle to simulate focus)

State definitions and microcopy (examples):
- Empty (no resources): title: "No routes yet"; body: "Create your first route to start serving models. Need help? Try the Quickstart."; CTA: "Create route"
- In-progress (creating route): title: "Route in progress"; body: "We’re provisioning capacity — this usually takes < 90s."; CTA: "View progress"
- Success: title: "Ready to test"; body: "Your route is active. Start sending requests or try the interactive playground."; CTA: "Open playground"
- Error: title: "Something blocked creation"; body: "Permissions or quota required. See details for next steps."; CTA: "Troubleshoot"

Acceptance criteria (must-haves):
- Compact tile and empty-state illustration assets exported as SVG + 1x/2x/3x PNGs for all three themes.
- All components documented in Figma with spacing tokens, color tokens, and responsive constraints.
- Microcopy variants A/B ready (A: more directive CTAs, B: more discoverable help links) with copy stored in Confluence and attached to component variants.
- Accessibility: color contrast passes WCAG AA for foreground text; illustrations include descriptive alt text examples in spec.
- Interaction notes: microtips dismissible, pinned state persists with analytics event fired.

Analytics & instrumentation (hand-off to ENG):
- Events to include: onboarding.tile_shown, onboarding.tile_cta_click, onboarding.microtip_dismiss, onboarding.empty_view_help_click
- Suggested properties: user_tier, region, route_type, overlay_variant

Design constraints & decisions log:
- Decision 2025-02-14 (Maya): prefer neutral baseline theme for first-run and expose 'spark' as a progressive reward theme after completion. Rationale: reduces cognitive load on first exposure and aligns with Console color palette.
- Decision 2025-02-16 (Tomas): collapse long descriptive copy into 1 line on mobile; copy longer than 100 chars will be truncated in compact tile.
- Trade-off: detailed onboarding may reduce exploratory learning; chosen approach favors shorter CTAs + help links.

Review notes and threaded feedback (chronological):
- 2025-02-15 PM (Elena Park): "Love the compact tiles — can we add an explicit help link for enterprise users who need RBAC steps?" → Added help link variant and label for enterprise copy.
- 2025-02-17 ENG (Samir Patel): "We need exact pixel values for marquee overlay and a breakpoint table for the responsive behavior." → Added breakpoint table and exported overlay mask (screenshot_overlay_callout_v1.png).
- 2025-02-18 Design review (Maya): "Update iconography to be line-weight consistent with Console core icons. Replace rounded shadow with flat elevation token." → Done in tokens page.
